problem: Open Permit Fees is a public dataset of US building-permit fee schedules. If you are a permit expediter, a construction cost-estimation team, or a construction-software product manager, the jurisdiction you need may not be in the dataset yet.
offer_summary: Commission one jurisdiction for $249, once. You get a purpose-built extractor plus the full fee schedule, with every row cited to the page and line of the adopting document, delivered as a pull request to the public repository within 10 business days under CC BY 4.0.

delivery.method: pull request to the public repository

request.notice: The GitHub issue form is a request for review. Submitting it does not purchase anything. Checkout is off, so nothing is charged at submission; if the request moves forward, a human sends any later payment link.
